name: Crushed
source:
Corey’s winter break gets a lot more interesting when the love of his life, ahem, his newest crush moves to Thomastown. Can he convince the new kid to give him a chance or will he fumble at love once again?

[From [url=https://hummingbird-games.itch.io/crushed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
當柯里一生摯愛——咳，是他最新的暗戀對象——搬到托馬斯鎮時，他的寒假頓時有趣了許多。他能說服這個新來的男孩給自己一次機會，還是又要在愛情面前搞砸一切？

[摘自[url=https://hummingbird-games.itch.io/crushed]itch.io[/url]]
